_meta.verification_rule: Every row cites the venue's own official page in source_url. Any field that could not be read from that page is left empty and carries an *_flag explanation. Nothing is inferred.
_meta.excluded: Broadway shows, The Edge, Circle Line, Chelsea Market and similar were NOT listed because no first-party price/hours page was verified in this pass. They are candidates for a later pass, not silently dropped.
_meta.transport_rule: Rows whose own official page states a >1 hour transit time from Midtown are marked in transport_note.
_meta.hours_capture_note: Official baseline hours captured 2026-11-25. A populated hours cell is the venue’s current published baseline, not a guarantee for 15–22 Feb 2027; holiday, weather, and service exceptions still need date-specific re-checks.
_meta.hours_source_rule: Rows with a separate official hours page expose it in hours_source_url, and the Activities renderer shows both the primary official page and the official hours page.

activities.name: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
activities.exceptions: MoMA is open every day except Thanksgiving and Christmas. Friday 17:30–20:30 is Uniqlo Free Friday Nights for NY State residents with advance reservation. Stores and restaurants have different hours.
activities.price_note: Adult $30; seniors 65+ $22; students $17; 16 and under free. Tickets include all galleries and special exhibitions.
activities.transport_note: B/E/M at 5th Ave–53 St or N/R/W at 5th Ave–59 St.
